description: Convert a CLASSIC ABAP REPORT (REPORT ... PARAMETERS / SELECT-OPTIONS, event blocks, WRITE list, ALV) into an abap2UI5 app class of the abap-cloud-gui addon (inherits z2ui5_cl_cgui_report: selection_screen( ), start_of_selection( ), write( ), alv( ), message( )) - deterministically, by its converter report2cloud. Answers the generated files (class source, abapGit sidecar, local-class includes), the MIGRATION REPORT (markdown: the TODOs, the unreleased tables and APIs to replace for ABAP Cloud with successor hints, what was not carried over, every mapped construct by line) and the REFUSALS (file:row:col and the reason - dynpros, batch input, SUBMIT, native SQL; a refused report yields no class unless `partial`). A report that carries open-abap's `@KERNEL` escape (WRITE '@KERNEL ...' becomes JavaScript once transpiled) is refused whole, before anything is converted; a dynamic WHERE (cond) is converted and named under `warnings`. A class too large for one answer leaves the mapped-construct table and then the files out (`files_left_out` says so - deploy: true and read_app reach them). Pass the .prog.xml as `texts_xml` for the real selection texts and text symbols. `deploy: true` also writes the class with the addon's runtime and popups into the dev sandbox, builds the local backend and answers app_start's agent snapshot of its selection screen (continue with app_act). For a NEW app use app_guide and scaffold_app instead; this tool is for an existing report.

class_name.description: optional: the class to generate (default zcl_ + the report name, e.g. zcl_flights for ZFLIGHTS)

deploy.description: optional: deploy the class (with abap-cloud-gui's src/01 - its classes, interfaces and the variant/layout store tables - and the popups it calls) into the dev sandbox, build_backend and app_start it; the answer gains `deploy` with each stage (default false)

partial.description: optional: on refusals, still return the draft class with the refused statements marked (default false)

texts_xml.description: optional: the report's abapGit <report>.prog.xml - its text pool (selection texts, text symbols, title); without it the texts are placeholders and TODOs

name: migrate_report
